On November 12, 2025 at 9:20 PM MT a Waymo Autonomous Vehicle ("Waymo AV") operating in Phoenix, Arizona was in a collision involving a passenger car at 3400 Sky Harbor Boulevard, Terminal 3 at the Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport.
